answer: Adaptive Delay Wedge: each new identity must submit its first N transactions with an enforced minimum inter-arrival gap, calibrated to the onyx baseline of honest agents. Honest users converge to a smooth ripple of steady spacing; a sybil cluster reveals a sharp vertex in arrival-time histograms because batch-created identities fire nearly simultaneously. Enforcement is local: nodes reject bursts exceeding the gap threshold, forcing serialization. An attacker running 10,000 identities must pay 10,000 times the wall-clock delay, turning cheap mass registration into months of throttled traffic.
